tei:div.tei:p: gna' rtsom ni ma rigs srol rgyun rig gnas kyi grub cha gal chen zhig yin cing*/ krung hwa mi rigs kyi 'od stong 'bar ba'i rig gnas shul bzhag khrod kyi rin bu zhig yin/ de 'tshol sdud dang*/ dag sgrig tho 'god/ par skrun bcas byed rgyu ni rang re'i tang dang rgyal khab rigs phul byung rig gnas rgyun 'dzin byed pa'i bya ba rlabs chen zhig yin pas/ rang rgyal mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong bca' khrims sogs bca' khrims dang srid jus su gsal por gtan la phab yod cing*/ rim khag gi mi dmangs srid gzhung nas 'di phyogs kyi bya ba 'bor chen bsgrubs shing*/ grub 'bras g.yur du zab blangs/ nye ba'i lo shas ring*/ rgyal srid spyi khyab khang nas grangs nyung mi rigs gna' rtsom nang du 'dus pa'i rang rgyal mi rigs gna' rtsom 'tshol sdud dang*/ dag sgrig tho 'god sogs byed pa'i thad ched du yig cha phud de gtan phab gsar ba mdzad cing*/ blang bya gsar ba bton/ spyi khyab hru'u ci nas kyang gna' rtsom dag sgrig par skrun sgos mes rgyal gyi phul byung rig gnas shul bzhag rgyun 'dzin byas te/ krung go'i khad chos ldan pa'i spyi 2)tshogs ring lugs 'dzugs skrun la zhabs 'degs zhu dgos zhes pa'i bka' slob legs par bstsal/ gong gsal dgongs don lag star dngos 'bab byed ched/ nga tshos rang skyong khul gyi don dngos dang zung 'brel byas te/ ched gnyer las khungs btsugs shing*/ ched mkhas mi sna skong 'then dang ci nus sgos mthun rkyen bskrun pa'i rmang gzhi'i steng de'i byed nus 'don skul byas te/ bya ba 'di cung snga ba'i sgo nas las 'go brtsams/ nga tsho'i thog ma'i rgyus lon ltar na/ mgo log sa cha'i gna' rtsom la mtshon na thon khungs cung 'bel bo yin par ma zad/ brgyud pa ring zhing*/ rnam grangs mang la/ khyab rgya che ba dang*/ nang gses rigs kyis dbye na'ang brda sprod dang*/

rtsom rig lo rgyus/ gso rig mtshan nyid rig pa/ rtsis gzhung*/ nang don rig pa sogs bod kyi srol rgyun rig gnas kyi khyab khongs phal mo che zin cing*/ dpe rgyun dkon zhing rtsa chen du brtsi rung ba'i gna' gzhung yang mi nyung bar 'dug de phyir thog ma'i tshol sdud tsam gyi rmang gyi rmang gzhi'i steng*/ 1993 lo nas bzung ste/ mgo log sa cha'i mkhas dbang rim byon gyi gsung rtsom gces bsgrigs dpe tshogs kyi tshul du khra dge slong tshul khrims 3)dar rgyas kyi gsung rtsom gces bsgrigs]sogs snga gzhug tu deb lnga drug tsam par skrun byas te/ rgya che'i klog pa po'i spyan sngar rim par bstar bas/ kun kyi gdeng 'jog legs po byung zhing*/ bya ba de la 'brel yod sde khag gis mthong gzigs gnang ste/ ched gnyer las khungs dang mi sna sogs la zhing chen rim pa'i gna' rtsom 'tshol sdud myur skyob kyi bya dga' dang gzengs bstod kyi dbugs dbyung thengs du mar gnang*/ nye lam rgyal khab mi rigs don byed u yon lhan khang gis ( krung go'i grangs nyung mi rigs gna' rtsom spyi byang gnad bsdu sa)lag star byed pa'i shar rlung gi 'gros dang bstun zhing*/ rang skyong khul gyi srid dbang btsugs nas lo 'khor lnga bcu 'khor bar sngon bsu zhu ba'i sta gon rtsom pa dang 'brel/ khul gna' rtsom bya ba'i gzhung las khang gis sngar gyi rmang gzhi'i steng rim pa spags shing gzhi rgya bskyed de/ slar yang ( mgo log dpe rnying dpe tshogs )'tshol sdud dang*/ dag sgrig par skrun bcus byed pa'i jus gzhi gsar ba bzos pa ltar nga tshos bya ba 'di da lta dngos su lag star byed 'go brtsams pa yin/ de yang nga tshos bya ba 'di nyid sgrub pa'i mdzub ston bsam blo ni tang krung dbyang dang rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi 'brel yod mdzub ston 4)la brtsi srung sgos/ mi rigs phul byung rig gnas dar spel dang*/

mi rigs mthun sgril dang rig gnas brje res la shugs snon byed pa dmigs 'dun du byas te/ bden 'tshol lam/ tshan rig dang mthun pa'i spyod stangs la brten nas sa gnas mi rigs gna' rtsom sngog 'don myur skyob byas thog mi rigs kyi khyad chos ldan pa'i spyi tshogs ring lugs dpal yon 'dzugs skrun la zhabs 'degs zhu rgyu de yin/ bya ba'i rtsa don ni chab srid 'du shes shugs dam zhing*/ srid jus dbye mtshams gsal bor byas te/ lo rgyus dang rtsod sgrub kyi lta ba spyad nas snyigs dor bcud len byed pa'i dus mtshungs su rig gnas kyi ngos nas snga ma'i rnam pa ji bzhin cha tshang du mtshon ci nus byed cing*/ spyir btang du brtsams chos la dpyad brjod ci yang byed rgyu min/ gzhan yang byed sgo'i shes byar slob sbyong dang*/ ched las shes byar gtsigs 'dzin byas te/ nan tan zhib tshags kyi bya ba'i spyod stangs la brten nas gnad sgo stangs 'dzin byas thog rgyun shes sam ched las rang bzhin gyi 'gal 'khrul g.yol ci nus byed rgyu'ang smros ma dgos/ de dang mnyam du spus legs 'du shes chags par byas te/ ma 5)dngul gyi mthun rkyen cung 'byor ba'i gnas tshul 'og [ dpe tshogs ]de jus 'god dang*/ mdun shog deb tshad/ shog spus/ ye ge'i dag tshad sogs gang rung nas de sngon las spus tshad bzang bar byas te/ mig snga'i rgyal nang sa gnas bod yig dpe deb cung legs po'i gras su tshud par byed pa dmigs 'ben du byas yod/ 'dir cis kyang gleng dgos pa zhig ni de ring nga tshor bya ba 'di spel ba'i go skabs byung tshe/ nga tshor 'di 'dra'i rig gnas shul bzhag rgya che zhing rngams mthug pa zhig myur skyob bya ru yod cing*/ mang po zhig da dung med brlag tu ma song bar 'tshol du yod pa dang de tsho'i rig gnas rin thang gi skor yin te/ de yang de sngon gyi lo rgyus su rang re gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir 'gro ba mi yi sha tshugs su skyes pa ni sus kyang bgrang du med mod/

legs par bsam na mi rigs dang mi'i rigs la 'phral yun du phan pa'i mdzad pa bzang po bskrun pa dang nyams pa med pa'i legs skyes shul du bzhag yod mkhan ni shin tu nyung ngu zhig las med na/ khong tsho ni mi yi khyu mchog dang*/ phul byung skyes bur bgrang ba don dang ldan te/ ji skad du/ mkhas pa rnams ni med na blo gros rnams nyams mi rnams 'tsho ba don yod min ces gsungs pa shin tu mad de/ khong tsho yod cing*/ khong tshos rang byung khams dang spyi tshogs la thugs gzhigs yang yang 6)mdzad pa las byung ba'i 'gro ba mi'i blo gros dang shes rab kyi mtshon byed shes rig gi legs skyes rmad du byung ba de dag yod pa dang*/ legs skyes de dag dus dang go mtshams kyi rgya las brgal te phyi rabs pa dag la pha nor gyi tshul du shul 'jog gnang bar brten/ nga tsho da lta dpal yon ldan pa'i spyi tshogs su 'tsho zhing*/ nga tshos bskrun pa'i shes rig la rmang gzhi dang khungs lung yod cing*/ brgyud pa dang ldan par gyur/ mkhas pa de tsho dang rig gzhung de tsho bzhugs pas rang gi rigs rgyud 'di rnams da lta brgyud pa ring la zab cing rgya che ba'i thun min rig gnas shig gi bdag por gyur yod la/ shes rig rnam par bkra ba dpal ldan 'dzam bu gling ba'i mi gral gyi star rim 'phang mi dmar bar 'tsho thub pa byung yod/ de phyir mkhas pa'i dbang po rim par byon pa dag dang de dag gis mdzad pa'i legs bshad kyi glegs bam dag ni mi rigs shig dang sa gnas shig la mtshon na gzi brjid dang la rgya zhig yin 'dug la/ 'chang bar bya ba'i khyad nor dag 'phyar bar bya ba'i dge mtshan zhig yin par ma zad/ 'tsho bar byed pa'i bla srog dang khrag rgyun zhig tu smras kyang rung snyam/ 'di ltar bsam na khong sngon byon gyi mkhas pa dag rang re la bka' drin bla lhag tu che bas rjes su yi rang zhing snying nas bka' drin zhu 'os la/

sngon 'gro'i rtsom thung 7)'di yang khong rnam par dad gdung mos gus kyi yid rlabs g.yo bzhin bris pa lags/ dus mtshungs su rang re gangs can pa dag la gna' bo'i dus nas bzung mkhas pa la gong bkur dang shes rig la gces thang che ba'i srol rgyun bzang po zhig yod la/ yul mgo log 'dir mtshon na'ang dgon sde dang dge 'dun pa dag gis bshad sgrub kyi ngos nas so so'i mkhas pa dang de'i brtsams chos la gtsigs su 'dzin pa tsam du ma zad/ yul khams spyi nas kyang mkhas pa yon tan ldan pa dang*/ skra dkar yang tsha mthong ba ste sogs kyis mtshon te mkhas pa dag phu dud bya ba'i yul gsum gyi gtso bo'i go gnas su bgrang ba'i srol 'dug cing*/ khong tsho ni legs bshad kyi 'byung gnas dang*/ legs tshogs kyi rtsa ba/ yi rang dang mig ltos kyi mtshon dpe zhig tu brtsi ba dang*/ khong tshos brtsams pa'i gsung chos dag ni bslab bya'i gnas shig dang*/ lugs gnyis blang dor gyi tshad gzhi zhig tu brtsi bar byed/ khyim rgyud dang rus rgyud dag la mtshon na rang gi khyim rgyud du 'khrungs pa'i mkhas pa dang de'i gsung chos de tsho so so rang rang gi khyim rgyud kyi khyad nor du byas te/ bu rabs tsha rgyud du bsrel bar byed pa'i dar srol yod pas/ dus 'gyur mang po'i khrod du'ang srog dang bsdos nas srung skyob byas 'dug da lta bsam na 'di ni 8)goms srol legs po tsam du ma zad snying stobs rigs shig gi mtshon byed du'ang rung bar snyam/ de dag gi dbang gis sa gnas 'dir yang lo rgyus su mkhas pa mi nyung ba tsam byon cing*/ da lta'i bar 'tshol du yod pa'i legs bshad kyi bstan bcos kyang mang tsam bzhugs la/ de tsho'i thun min rin thang gi cha nas bshad na'ang lo rgyus su mgo log 'di mdo khams 'brel mtshams su chags yod pas/ mdo khams rigs gnas ma lag che ba gnyis ka gcig 'dres su song ba'i nyams shig snang la/

bod brgyud nang bstan grub mtha'i dbang du btang na'ang snga 'gyur rnying ma ba dang*/ ri bo dge lugs pa/ rgyal ba jo nang ba/ mnyam med bka' brgyud pa sogs grub mtha'i che gras phal mo che zhig yun ring mnyam gnas su chags pas/ dmangs khrod rig gnas tshun gyi rig gnas kun la sa cha gzhan dag mi mtshungs pa'i sger khyad cig lhag ger snang bar bsten/ rig gnas shul bzhag 'di rigs myur skyob thub pa byung na/ bod spyi'i srol rgyun rig gnas kyi dar rgyun nam brgyud pa gyes 'phel 'gro tshul dang*/ sa gnas thun min rig gnas grub stangs sogs zhib 'jug byed par don snying dang rin thang shin tu che bar gdon mi za la/ tha na bod kyi srol rgyun rig gnas kyi nang gses phyogs rer mtshon na de phyogs kyi stong cha gsab 9)nus pa'i tshad du son pa'i rin thang yang yod par zhib 'jug mkhas dbang du ma smra/ gang ltar da lta nga tshos ( mgo log dpe rnying dpe tshogs )'di nyid par du bskrun te mgo log gna' rtsom gyi spyi bab khyad chos dang ngo mtshar kun gyi spyan sngar bstar thub pa ni tang gi mi rigs srid jus don 'bab byung ba'i bye brag gi mtshon dpe zhig yin la/ mgo log rig gnas khyab khongs kyi grub 'bras chen po zhig yin cing*/ krung go'i grangs nyung mi rigs gna' rtsom bya ba'i grub 'bras kyi ya gyal zhig kyang yin pa dang*/ deng dus la dge ba'i mdzad bzang zhig dang*/ ma 'ongs par bslangs pa'i rdo ring zhig ste/ lo rgyus kyi don snying ldan pa'i bya ba rlabs che ba zhig yin pa bsnyon du med la/ sa gnas thun min rig gnas thon khungs sngog 'don sgos khyad thon rig gnas dar spel byed cing*/ rang skyong khul gyi rig gnas brje res dang phyi phyogs dril sgrog la shugs snon byed par mtshon na don snying chen po tshab byed gzhan du med pa zhig yod par snyam zhing*/ dus mtshungs su (

dpe tshogs )'di nyid kyis rgya che'i klog pa po dang 'brel yod zhib 'jug pa dag la'ang rig pa'i longs spyod gsar ba zhig ston nus pa'i yid ches nga tshor yod/ de sngon gyi srid jus legs po'i go skabs ma shor bar byas te/ 10)cha rkyen zhan cing dka' tshegs che ba la ma ltos par mthun rkyen gsar gtod sgos 'tshol sdud dang*/ dag sgrig myur skyob kyi las la rang rtogs ngang zhugs nas sa gnas rig gnas shul bzhag rtsa chen dag chus zos su mi 'gro ba'i ched du 'bad pa yun ring bsten pa'i ched las don gnyer mi sna dag gis don mthun gyi bya ba mang po bsgrubs song bas/ ngas 'dir khong tshor dka' las myang song zhes zhu zhing*/ kho bo rang ngos kyis bya ba de la rgyab skyor dang mthun rkyen sbyor ba'ang ldog med kyi 'os 'gan zhig tu brtsis yod/ 'on kyang rang khul gyi gna' rtsom ma lus par yongs su myur skyob byed rgyu ni da dung dus yun ring zhing dka' khag che ba'i bya ba zhig yin pas/ grub 'bras kyi rmang gzhi'i steng mu 'thud nas rgyun 'khyongs lhod med kyi bya ba 'bor chen zhig bsgrub pa la rag las yod/ mjug mthar mgo log gna' rtsom bya ba legs 'grub yong zhing*/ grub 'bras gzengs su thon pa'i smon 'dun zhu/ zhes pad ma rnam rgyal nas 2002 1 1 la bris/
